The Broadnet 5G preset requires one selected SIM identified as China Broadnet. Select that SIM and reload its configuration.

Prepares VoLTE, 5G NR including SA, VoNR and advanced calling, and checks and adds missing Broadnet APNs when you apply. Preserves Wi-Fi calling and roaming Wi-Fi calling settings and manual drafts. Review the pending changes, then tap Apply changes.
Complete China Broadnet APNs

Pending: check the data and dedicated IMS APNs. Suitable existing entries are reused; missing entries are added while preserving existing entries. The app does not actively switch an existing preferred data APN. Choosing another preset, loading history or discarding the draft cancels this APN task.

Reference entries for missing APNs:
Data: cbnet · default,ia,supl,xcap
IMS: ims · ims
New entries use IPV4V6 for normal and roaming protocols. APN entries may be shared by Broadnet SIMs with the same home network.
